## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build` passes (type-check, the boundary check, the bundle)
- [ ] `npm run test:headless` passes
- [ ] A game imports only from `@platform` / `@platform/client`, and is listed in `src/games/browser.ts` and `src/games/server.ts` with a `cover.webp`
- [ ] Names are original (parody welcome, no real trademarks)
- [ ] Assets are my own, generated in the repo, or MIT-compatible (sources below)
